scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I submitted a loan application and I'm checking on its status. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional home purchase loan has been denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what was the interest rate that was considered for my application?
dialogue.agent: The principal reason for the denial is "other." The record does not include the interest rate considered for your application.

dialogue.user: I understand. What does "other" mean as a reason for denial? Is there any additional information you can provide about the denial? Also, what are the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The record does not provide specific details about what "other" means as a reason for denial. There are no additional reasons for denial listed. The record does not include the total costs associated with the loan.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan does not have a high-cost mortgage classification under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. The loan was not sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I have a few more questions. What type of loan product was I approved for, and what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: You were not approved for any loan product. The loan was denied. Your debt-to-income ratio is less than 20%.

dialogue.user: I see. Thank you for the information. I'm a bit disappointed that my application was denied, but I appreciate your help. <Satisfied> The information was clear, and I understand the outcome.
